h:
Flux-Kontext 可以轻松地将任何图像中的字符合并到一张图片中。

V4 - 添加功能参考背景

在这个版本 4 中，我使用了与我的另一个工作流程将角色合并到背景图像中。我必须说它并不是100%完美。

有时合并失败并且什么也没有发生。我不确定真正的原因是什么，但我发现如果我继续按创建和随机种子或调整填充的大小并调整图像的大小，合并将会成功。

一些观察结果表明，它似乎在图像大小 1024px - 1536px 下效果很好

而低于1024px我在多轮测试中始终无法成功合并两个图像。

最后，有时如果我们幸运的话，图像会有阴影，使其看起来更真实并且不会太漂浮。

V3 - 更新提高性能

V3

  • v2 中的所有内容在 v3 中仍然可用，但我删除了不必要的步骤并对其进行了优化以使用更少的内存资源。

  • 增加人数超过3人并不是很困难。您可以查看我的 dicut 逻辑并自行添加更多内容，或者使用与示例图像相同的上传图像。

  • 按照我的场景管理人员指南切换图像节点。

  • Trick -> 绕过组合背景并重新计算角色位置，直到您满意为止。然后启用并运行完整的工作流程

V2

  • 版本2我们可以重新定位角色（用于外涂的垫图像的概念）

  • 技巧 -> 绕过分组字符过程并重新计算字符位置，直到您满意为止。然后启用并运行完整的工作流程

V1

  • 版本 1 是简单的工作流程，不支持重新定位字符

o.en:
Flux-Kontext easy merge character from any image to 1 Picture.

V4 - Add feature reference background

In this version 4, I have used the same technique similar toanother workflow of mineto merge the character into the background image. I must say that it is not 100% perfect.

Sometimes the merge fails and nothing happens. I am not sure what the real reason is but I have found that if I keep pressing create and random seed or adjusting the size of the padding and resizing the image, the merge will succeed.

Some observations are that it seems to work well in the size of the image 1024px - 1536px

And below 1024px I have never been able to successfully merge the two images in many rounds of testing.

And finally, sometimes if we lucky, the image will have a shadow, making it look more realistic and not too floating.

V3 - Update improve performance

V3

  • Every thing in v2 still available in v3, But I cut out unnecessary steps and optimized it to use less memory resources.

  • Increasing the number of people more than 3 is not very difficult. You can look at my dicut logic and add it more by yourself or use upload image same like example image .

  • Switch image node by following my guide for manage people in scene.

  • Trick -> bypass Group combine background and recalculate position of character Until you are satisfied. Then enable back and run full workflow

V2

  • version 2 we canrepositioningcharacter (concept of pad image for outpaint)

  • trick -> bypass Group character process and recalculate position of character Until you are satisfied. Then enable back and run full workflow

V1

  • version 1 is simple workflow not support reposition character
